components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Action-blue control for direct task progression.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.1rem; border: 1.5px solid #1e66f5; border-radius: 6px; background: #1e66f5; color: #fff; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #1654d1; border-color: #1654d1; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(30,102,245,0.3); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30,102,245,0.2); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e66f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White bordered control for reversible or supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.1rem; border: 1.5px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #1e1e2e; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #1e66f5; color: #1e66f5; background: rgba(30,102,245,0.03); } .ds-button-secondary:active { background: #eff6ff; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e66f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Consequence-rose control for destructive or physically consequential confirmation.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.1rem; border: 1.5px solid #9f1239; border-radius: 6px; background: #9f1239; color: #fff; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background: #830e2e; border-color: #830e2e; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(159,18,57,0.3); } .ds-button-danger:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e66f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet transparent control for dismissal and tertiary navigation.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.1rem; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: rgba(30,102,245,0.08); color: #1e66f5; } .ds-button-ghost:active { background: rgba(30,102,245,0.12); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e66f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Clinical white input with a strong boundary and connected label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem; border: 1.5px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #374151; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #9399b2; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1e66f5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(30,102,245,0.15); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped categorical filter with a visibly pressed state.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #6b7280; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { border-color: #1e66f5; color: #1e66f5; } .ds-filter-chip-selected { border-color: #1e66f5; background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e66f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Literal outlined job status with contrast-safe text and ring.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border: 1.5px solid #166534; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #166534; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Flat white reading surface separated from the page by a quiet border.
components.html:
Template library

Find, assess, and safely maintain existing templates.

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Dark-rail destination with a reinforced active marker.
components.html: Templates
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.38rem 0.6rem 0.38rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: rgba(205,214,244,0.8); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 20%; bottom: 20%; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: #1e66f5; opacity: 0; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: rgba(30,102,245,0.15); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item-active::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #89b4fa; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: Floating confirmation panel for actions with operational or physical consequence.

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(560px, 100%); padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #374151; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; color: #1e1e2e; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; } .ds-dialog button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0.48rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 0.825rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1.5px solid #d1d5db; background: #fff; color: #1e1e2e; } .ds-dialog-confirm { border: 1.5px solid #9f1239; background: #9f1239; color: #fff; } .ds-dialog button:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e66f5; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
PrintOps feels like a well-kept clinical notebook: precise, calm, and trustworthy. Every element is a deliberate record, placed for rapid scanning rather than decoration. The interface recedes behind the operator's task while keeping physical-output consequences unmistakable.

The system is light-first and restrained. Familiar system typography, compact controls, quiet borders, and flat reading surfaces suit long shifts under fluorescent hospital lighting. Brand character comes from disciplined blue accents, exact spacing, bilingual resilience, and honest operational states—not visual spectacle.

Motion is limited to short state feedback and spatial transitions that explain where an overlay or drawer came from. All motion has an instant reduced-motion fallback. The visual system rejects flashy SaaS gradients, terminal-dense data walls, generic component-library styling, and dark-first interfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Light-first surfaces tuned for clinical workstations
Flat-by-default depth with elevation reserved for overlays, drawers, and consequential controls
System-native sans-serif typography with monospace reserved for technical evidence
One action-blue family plus explicit semantic state colors
Restrained surface corners with pills reserved for compact status and filtering
Keyboard-complete controls, 44px touch targets, and equal English/Thai support

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Action Blue is the only non-semantic accent. Its restraint makes focus, selection, and the next safe action immediately recognizable.

rules.name: The Literal Status Rule
rules.body: Never merge, rename, or imply a server status through color alone. Preserve the literal label, pair it with a contrast-safe outline or explicit text, and keep `UNVERIFIED` visually distinct from `FAILED`.

rules.name: The Consequence Color Rule
rules.body: Rose signals destructive or physically consequential action, not ordinary emphasis. Routine primary actions remain blue or neutral.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Use system fonts only. Do not load display fonts or create a decorative headline layer.

rules.name: The Evidence Layer Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where the exact string matters operationally; ordinary prose and labels stay sans-serif.

rules.name: The Thai Integrity Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and letter-spacing are optional Latin treatments, never global label requirements. Thai glyph clusters must remain unmodified and layouts must tolerate longer localized copy.

rules.name: The One Task Per Mobile View Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, show the list or the focused maintenance task—not both side by side. Navigation back to the parent context must remain explicit.

rules.name: The Touch Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive targets are at least 44px on coarse pointers and mobile widths, even when their desktop visual footprint remains compact.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and page regions are border-defined at rest. Add a shadow only when the element floats above, moves over, or must be distinguished from the current plane.

rules.name: The Directional Depth Rule
rules.body: Drawers cast depth away from their attached edge; centered overlays use ambient depth. Shadow direction must explain spatial origin.

rules.name: The Restrained Corner Rule
rules.body: Use 4–8px corners for ordinary surfaces and controls. Use full pills only for status or filtering, never for primary buttons or large containers.

dos: Do use White reading surfaces on Page Gray and quiet borders for primary structure.
Do preserve literal operational states, especially `UNVERIFIED`, and pair every status color with text, outline, shape, or icon.
Do keep proof generation and physical printing visibly separate; generating or refreshing a proof must never trigger output.
Do require a distinct confirmation for every physical print and block printing while printer readiness is offline or unknown.
Do use shared Button, Dialog, Alert, FormField, PageState, and StatusBadge primitives where they fit.
Do maintain visible focus, keyboard operation, 44px touch targets, reduced-motion behavior, and bilingual EN/TH resilience.
Do use mobile cards or focused next-step views when a dense desktop table or split workspace would compete for attention.
donts: Don't use gradients, decorative glows, oversized display type, or animation as decoration.
Don't create terminal-dense dashboards or expose expert payload controls as the default operator workflow.
Don't default to dark mode in fluorescent clinical environments.
Don't invent new accent colors or arbitrary one-off font sizes when a token already serves the role.
Don't use color as the only communicator or lower contrast for secondary operational text.
Don't place shadows on ordinary table rows, section headings, or static cards.
Don't use pill-shaped primary buttons or large rounded containers; pills belong to compact status and filtering.
Don't truncate critical identifiers or safety copy without a discoverable full value.
